Ana Lopez: Dropping a new take on the Versions timeline: group by day but show a condensed action row per cluster (quick pause, promote, revert). Mock: https://redwood.design/mocks/versions/day-group-actions Tom Rivera: Nice. My worry: too many actions visible could be scary. Could we hide dangerous actions behind a secondary click? Ana Lopez: Agree on hiding destructive ops. Idea: primary actions (promote) visible, destructive (rollback, pause) behind a chevron reveal or long-press on mobile. Priya Shah: For keyboard users, long-press is no-go. We'd need a discoverable keystroke or focusable reveal. Maybe a small "more" button with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. Ibrahim: Accessibility nit: When the "more" menu opens, ensure the first menuitem gets focus and the menu has role="menu" and aria-label="version actions". Screen readers need clear context. Priya Shah: Proposed markup: ```html
``` Tom Rivera: That works. Also, visual density: when clusters are collapsed, only show a tiny sparkline and date label to keep vertical rhythm. Expanding reveals full list with action rows. QA - Keiko: Testing note: when you expand multiple clusters in succession, focus must follow the last expanded cluster. Otherwise keyboard users get lost. Also verify that keyboard shortcut (e.g., "e") toggles expansion when cluster header is focused. deploy-bot: Canary run: variant a -> 10% -> 40% -> metric: latency +12% -> auto-hold triggered. Logged: 1930056789-canary-autohold Ana Lopez: UX question: auto-hold toast should include a one-click "Open rollback" and "Investigate" buttons. For screen reader, it needs role="alert" and focusable links. Ibrahim: For the toast copy, avoid ambiguous language. Use: "Canary auto-hold: increased latency detected. Traffic frozen at 40%." Then actions. Priya Shah: Copy tweak noted. Also we should add a small inline reason indicator on the cluster when auto-hold happens: a red pill "Auto-hold: latency" so teams scanning timeline can triage. Tom Rivera: Regarding A/B experiments: we should surface experiment IDs and variant labels in the cluster popover. Engineers need traceability to metrics dashboards. Maybe a link icon next to variant name that opens experiment details in a new tab. QA - Keiko: Accessibility checklist I'll run: 1) menu keyboard nav 2) alert toast SR announce + focus trapping not allowed 3) long list scanning with cluster grouping 4) tooltips and links open in new tab announced. Report by EOD tomorrow. design-bot: Uploaded updated mock with action-row + aria examples: https://redwood.design/mocks/versions/day-group-actions-v2 Ana Lopez: Thanks all. I'll iterate to hide rollback behind the menu, add the auto-hold pill, and update copy per Ibrahim. Back with a new screenshot in ~2 hours. :v:
